No new mechanism; the hook already watches file edits and is the one reminder that demonstrably held. (Anthony, 2026-07-31.)

properties.question: You've said reflow2 should nudge an agent to use the right skill at the moment it's needed, rather than relying on the agent to remember. Nothing is currently being built to do that — do you want it built now, parked for later, or dropped?
